hypothesis: A joint receiver-relative-donor nonlinear vector message before fine-neighbor averaging may produce useful per-recipient mask features beyond selecting donor values. This is a distinct testable function class, not a confirmed task bottleneck or new information claim.
formula: Per inherited head: m_ij = W2 GELU(Wr xi + Wd (xj-xi) + b1) + b2; mean exactly allowed neighbors. Actual exact-cutoff rows use unchanged raw whole-leaf mean.
optimized_formula: Precompute (Wr-Wd)xi and Wd xj; add b1 and apply GELU on every edge BEFORE allowed mean; apply W2 and b2 AFTER mean by linearity. Same five parameters in reference and optimized paths. Float output/gradient equivalence is not yet measured.
own_only_control: Cut ALL donor paths: ordinary rows W2 GELU(Wr xi+b1)+b2; inherited tied fallback rows raw xi. Require exactly zero off-diagonal input gradients; actual fallback remains raw leaf mean.
